arm_definitions.plain_iid: 200000 synthetic 30-bit flows at p=0.30 and p=0.70, using the existing plain synthetic arm path
arm_definitions.twin_real_occupancy: existing count-level synthetic arm using exact cached prefix occupancy for services 0 and 1, with p=0.30 and q=0.70

preregistration.thinning_operation: within each law and each observed context, uniformly retain floor(r*n_context) flows and split retained zero/one counts by hypergeometric sampling
preregistration.occupancy_primary_statistic: mean across k=5..30 and both laws of the fraction of observed contexts with fewer than 5 retained transitions
preregistration.decision_rule: For an arm, deflation tracks thinning iff the primary sparse-context statistic is nondecreasing and fitted exponent p is nonincreasing as retained_fraction decreases across all five levels. The joint result tracks iff both arms satisfy this rule.
